steps.title: Roll movement and ailment avoidance
steps.action: Acquire rare Slink Boots with at least 14% fractured Spell Suppression. Use Deafening Essence of Loathing.
steps.continueWhen: At least 31% chance to Avoid Elemental Ailments and at least 25% increased Movement Speed.
steps.failureAction: Repeat the paid essence on the same base if movement is absent or too low. This smallest procedure omits speculative Eldritch prefix repair and stops on the required functional output.
